canonicalization.algorithm: UTF-8 RFC8785 canonical JSON of explicit schema version, exact ordered event payload, sources, mappings, selected/excluded row IDs, policy versions and expected revision; no floats; decimal lexemes remain strings
canonicalization.lexeme_change: new payload hash and new approval even when numerical value equal
canonicalization.event_order: economic date, source/action dependency order, stable event ID only when economic ordering immaterial; unresolved material same-day order blocks review_ready

precision_proposal.source_booked_cash: preserve; never overwrite with rounded recomputation
precision_proposal.residual: calculation-only; deterministic largest absolute component then stable ID; never create ledger effects
precision_proposal.booked_reconciliation_tolerance: zero after declared source rounding; any difference reported

guards: A needs_resolution edit creates a new immutable draft revision, never changes the old revision.
Retry from failed requires same immutable operation, valid/rebound exact approval, active fence and unchanged expected revision; terminal failure is not retryable.
Reprocessing validation_failed requires a new source-processing revision, not replacement of original bytes.
Cancellation and publication race conditionally on the same authoritative state; only one wins.
Published correction/reversal is a new draft/manifest/approval; published original remains published with supersession lineage.

The exceptional complete->staged recovery is only an expired/revoked-approval rebind of an unchanged payload: atomically advance fence, bind a new exact approval, retire old seal and record recovery audit. Reverify immutable content and reseal; old fence/seal cannot activate. A changed payload needs a new draft/operation key after cancelling old unfinished work.

publication.serialization_scope: owner + environment; one linear ledger head
publication.byte_budget_caveat: preflight exact DynamoDB stored-item accounting and request constraints; values include attribute names/metadata, not just JSON file size
publication.business_idempotency_retention: retained financial ledger lifecycle; no TTL expiration shortcut
final_atomic_set: conditional complete manifest -> published, same fence and digest
business idempotency and durable receipt publication
conditional approval consumption with exact hash/version/expiry/assurance/revocation preconditions
reader_algorithm: walk published manifest ancestry until known validated checkpoint
resolve complete immutable item set from manifest receipts in base store
materialize only pinned revision; return INTEGRITY_INCOMPLETE on missing expected content
bind pagination and caches to pinned revision, do not merge newer head
forbidden: use GSI/Stream as complete ledger authority
interpret S3 object creation as financial commit
exclude reversed original AND sum inverse
publication.fencing: monotonic token scoped to manifest; all chunk/seal/activation writes check token and state; lease clock alone cannot fence a stale worker
publication.checkpoint: optional immutable verified projection linked to full parent revision and digest; not correctness authority without rebuild proof
publication.manifest_inventory: Bounded inline header or immutable paged child manifests; every page/chunk count and digest checked before complete. No header/item may exceed service item limit.
publication.chunk_reuse_on_recovery: Previously immutable chunk content may be referenced by a new-fence recovery receipt after full count/digest verification; historical old-fence completion receipts remain evidence, not new activation authority.
publication.content_hash_contract: hash-contract.json FIN-HASH-1: exact acyclic leaf -> chunk -> optional page -> manifest projections; actual synthetic proof in hash-graph-example.json
publication.delivery_records: Only immutable EventIntent enters chunk content. After-root PublicationPointer, mutable DeliveryState and append-only DeliveryAttempt are separately keyed and never part of sealed content; all join owner/environment/commit/message and require published authority.
publication.hash_exclusions: Own digest fields excluded explicitly; manifest activation envelope state/resulting_revision/published_at excluded. Fence and approval_id included. No implied full-record hash. Unknown schema fields are refused.

XIRR: dated complete boundary cash flows or explicit opening valuation period
at least2 distinct dates, positive duration, both aggregated signs
root uniqueness certificate or ambiguous result
TWR: valuation immediately before/after each boundary flow with supported timing
no interpolated substitute labelled exact TWR
basis_loss: positive known remaining basis and current value in same currency/boundary
approved analytical method or source-reported basis provenance
complete_portfolio_risk: complete required exposures and compatible paired return matrix
covariance finite, symmetric and positive semidefinite within declared numerical tolerance
metric_eligibility.missing_score_policy: abstain; no neutral substitution or automatic renormalization

flow_boundaries.sign: investor perspective: into measured investment negative, out positive

holding.linked_reinvestment: positive income and negative acquisition; same day may net zero

portfolio.internal_account_transfer: zero after matched cancellation; transit valued once
portfolio.in_kind_crossing: dated fair value required; otherwise unavailable

head and revision -> ordered published manifests/chunks/events
access_patterns.consistency: strong head plus immutable base manifest joins
access_patterns.index_need: revision ancestry and direct commit/chunk IDs

access_patterns.query: account/listing economic-date history at pinned revision
access_patterns.consistency: complete manifest-filtered paginated projection or authoritative replay

access_patterns.query: recorded-time changes, actor, denied operation, admin/export access
access_patterns.consistency: durable audit with high-watermark and lag evidence

access_patterns.query: pending/failed/stale-fence manifest and unmatched upload receipt/object
access_patterns.consistency: eventual discovery plus authoritative base validation

access_patterns.consistency: same pinned snapshot algorithm as all reads

retention.originals: 24-month renewable archive direction preserved; automatic deletion mechanics need separate policy
retention.financial_audit_approval_idempotency: duration and deletion consequences FIN-OD-08; never silently use operational TTL
retention.deletion: tombstone/evidence availability flags plus backups/restore erasure checks; no claim of complete retained source proof after deletion

approval_expiry_semantics.clock: trusted writer UTC immediately before each activation submission
approval_expiry_semantics.service_limitation: DynamoDB cannot evaluate a current server-clock expression in the transaction. A pre-expiry submitted transaction may finish after expiry.
approval_expiry_semantics.late_outcome: Resolve receipt; record submission/completion time. Do not retry a new activation after expiry without renewed approval. Strict commit-before-expiry is unproved and requires a separate owner decision.
